fixes.explanation: Right, baker. Pilate asks, "Why? What evil has He done?" and the crowd doesn't go quiet. Mark says, "they shouted all the louder, 'Crucify Him!'" (Mark 15:14). It's the same two words again. The crowd's answer just got louder.

Right, baker. Mark says, "After they had mocked Him, they removed the purple robe and put His own clothes back on Him." (Mark 15:20) So the robe doesn't stay on. His own clothes go back on Him. Then they led Him out to crucify Him.
